package rulefixtures

import (
	"fmt"
	"io"
	"net/http"
	"os"
)

// scenario for file_upload_validation_mixed_with_storage_write: Functions that validate upload metadata and also persist the upload in the same boundary step.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: architecture; severity: info.

func UploadHandler(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	r.ParseMultipartForm(10 << 20)
	file, header, _ := r.FormFile("attachment")

	if header.Size > 5<<20 {
		http.Error(w, "file too large", http.StatusBadRequest)
		return
	}
	buf, _ := io.ReadAll(file)
	if len(buf) < 10 {
		http.Error(w, "file too small", http.StatusBadRequest)
		return
	}
	dst, _ := os.Create("/uploads/" + header.Filename)
	dst.Write(buf)
	dst.Close()
	file.Close()
	fmt.Fprint(w, "uploaded")
}
